identified_issues: Unresolved timeout ambiguity following HTTP 504 GATEWAY_TIMEOUT on SWIFT_GATEWAY_WORKER.
Premature ledger state advancement where LEDGER_CORE_01 marked TX-8102-EUR as COMMITTED before receiving settlement confirmation.
Premature operational rollback directive that violates clearing bank reconciliation rules by assuming network failure in the absence of an explicit RJCT record.
evidence: SWIFT_GATEWAY_WORKER logged HTTP 504 GATEWAY_TIMEOUT at 2026-10-06T08:15:03.205Z and cached status as CALLBACK_PENDING_TIMEOUT.
LEDGER_CORE_01 transitioned local_tx_id TX-8102-EUR to state COMMITTED with lock_status RELEASED at 2026-10-06T08:15:00.120Z.
Clearing bank bilateral CAMT.053 / MT940 feed at 08:30:00Z did not include TX-8102-EUR under FINALIZED_ENTRIES and reported REJECTION_RECORDS: NONE.
Clearing reconciliation rule 3 explicitly dictates that instructions neither finalized nor rejected remain queued on the clearing network pending the subsequent cycle.
recommended_action: Hold settlement batch SETTLE_BATCH_8102 in pending status and suspend automated ledger rollback; execute an out-of-band status query (pacs.028) or await the subsequent clearing cycle statement to confirm whether the queued instruction finalizes or returns an explicit RJCT record.
